info.title: PIM_RPF
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

RPF_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Nexthop Interface to reach the source or RP Address.

RPF_nexthop_address.description: Nexthop address to reach the source or RP address.

address.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_RPF](#/PIM_RPF)
Source Address or the RP Address for the multicast groups that are being routed.

address_family.description: Represents the address family for this entry.

from.description: Represents the origin for this entry.

group_address.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_RPF](#/PIM_RPF)
When ECMP paths are available and user has configured multipath selection based on source and group addresses, different next-hops are choosen for different flows to achieve load splitting. This column indicates the group address of the multicast streams that are being routed. 0.0.0.0/:: indicates that this entry shows the next-hop details to reach a given source. When the group address is present, the entry indicates the next-hop choosen by PIM to reach a given source for the corresponding group.

is_pim_neighbor.description: Specifies whether the nexthop is PIM neighbor or not.

is_used.description: Represents if the RPF Entry is used or unused.

prefix.description: IPv4 or IPv6 Source Prefix. Example: 192.168.0.1/32.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_RPF](#/PIM_RPF)
Reference to a VRF, associated with this multicast L3 source or RP address entry.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
